title: Request for dealer photography and review services
not_questions: The photography studio places camera originals in Amazon S3.
We will not license Adobe Workfront for dealer photography.
Use the response column and identify the owner of each proposed acceptance check.
never_in_text: Request for dealer photography and review services

questions.label: A.1
questions.text: Describe how AEM Assets would distinguish a dealer-approved image of the right trim from a visually similar preproduction vehicle.

questions.label: A.2
questions.text: Explain the handoff from the studio's Amazon S3 delivery folder to AEM Assets when a reshoot replaces only one angle of a vehicle.

questions.label: A.3
questions.text: Provide an AEM Assets metadata design for model year, market, color and image rights that dealer staff can search without knowing a studio filename.

questions.label: A.4
questions.text: Show how AEM Assets would withdraw an image at the end of a talent agreement and evidence the replacement available to dealers.

questions.label: B.1
questions.text: Describe a Frame.io review for a walkaround video in which engineering and marketing disagree about the name of a safety feature.

questions.label: B.2
questions.text: Explain how a Frame.io reviewer would record a time-specific color objection and verify that the replacement cut addresses it.

questions.label: B.3
questions.text: Provide a Frame.io review handoff for a dealer film that needs distinct regional disclaimer edits while retaining a common approved master.

questions.label: B.4
questions.text: Explain how the producer would close a Frame.io review when an external agency submits a late change after dealer release approval.

questions.label: C.1
questions.text: Name the production lead and the metadata specialist assigned to our first vehicle line. State their availability during the summer shoot.

questions.label: C.2
questions.text: Provide a reference who can confirm your firm's handling of expiring image rights in a dealer or distributor network.

questions.label: C.3
questions.text: Quote the cost of onboarding a second studio and identify any price change if the number of vehicle trims doubles.

questions.label: C.4
questions.text: Describe the ownership and handover terms for your metadata dictionary and review templates when our contract ends.
